handoff_contract_choices: feed_ingest.validation: validate_summary(payload, game_id) and validate_scoreboard(payload) return None when valid and raise ValueError otherwise (sibling lineup convention); game_id must equal header.id.

feed_ingest.normalize.normalize_summary(payload, game_id, source='live', prior=None): one GameEvent per play in drives.previous[].plays[] with the exact store.put_event keys; score={'away','home'} from awayScore/homeScore; fieldPosition=start.yardsToEndzone; possession=offense teamParticipant id; playerIds=list drawn only from boxscore athlete ids (may be empty: play participants are $ref links); eventTime=wallclock; first revision 1 with correctionOf None; prior maps eventId->event, unchanged plays emit nothing, a changed play emits revision+1 with correctionOf=the superseded revision; source outside live/replay raises ValueError.
feed_ingest.normalize.broadcast_networks(payload): media.shortName list from header.competitions[0].broadcasts only (X05-OBS-001); the top-level broadcasts field is ignored.

feed_ingest.ingest.ingest_summary(payload, game_id, source='live'): validate before any write, store normalized events via the Events table, return them; a correction revises the stored row in place; re-ingesting an identical poll changes no revision.

feed_ingest.replay.load_events(game_id, fixtures_dir): verify index.json sha256 per CONTRACT-AFC-P2-FIXTURE (tamper or uncaptured game raises ValueError), then normalized events with source 'replay' on every value.

feed_ingest.monitoring.monitored_decisions(games, selected_player_ids, favorite_team_ids, enabled, basis): games are {'gameId','teamIds','playerIds'}; returns one {'gameId','monitored','basis'} per game in input order; monitored only when enabled and (a selected player or favorite team is in the game); basis must be 'observed-playback' or 'profile-assumption', anything else raises ValueError.
feed_ingest.lambda_handler(event, context) remains the template entry point; a non-schedule event raises ValueError (its polling behavior is exercised through ingest_summary offline).
